item.title: Ask HN: OpenCode no longer including DeepSeek?
item.summary: I noticed that OpenCode harness no longer is including DeepSeek. Does anyone know why? The current free models provided by OpenCode are currently: Nemotron (NVidia), Hy3 (Tencent), Muse Spark (Meta), Ox Alpha (stealth/unknown developer), Mimo (Xiaomi), Big Pickle (OpenCode).
